title: SovereignCoreHelmMapping
description: Schema for Sovereign Core deployment-acceleration Helm value-mapping files. These live alongside the software they accelerate under components/software/<company>/<product>/sovereigncore_ext/helm/.

softwareRef.description: Relative path to the parent SoftwareListing product folder (e.g. components/software/company-abc/nginx).

companyRef.description: Relative path to the canonical company profile (e.g. companies/company-abc).

repository.description: OCI URI of the upstream Helm chart (e.g. oci://registry.example.com/charts/nginx).

platformValueMappings.description: Key/value pairs mapping Helm chart values to Sovereign Core platform template expressions.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector labels to constrain scheduling to sovereign node pools.

tolerations.description: Kubernetes tolerations for sovereign node taints.
